reaction-duel.name: Reaction Duel
reaction-duel.blurb: Tap the instant the light turns green. Too early and you are out.
reaction-duel.tagline: Patience is a virtue. Jumping the gun is a loss.

button-masher.name: Button Masher
button-masher.blurb: Mash as fast as you can before the timer runs out.

color-trap.name: Color Trap
color-trap.blurb: Tap the INK color of the word, not what it spells. Wrong taps cost a point.

trivia.name: Lightning Quiz
trivia.blurb: Answer fast — correct answers score, and speed earns a bonus.

balloon-chicken.name: Balloon Chicken
balloon-chicken.blurb: Three balloons, the same for everyone: pump for points and cash out before each one pops.
balloon-chicken.tagline: Greed is good. Until it goes pop.

number-rush.name: Number Rush
number-rush.blurb: Tap the numbers 1 to 25 in order as fast as you can.

quick-math.name: Quick Math
quick-math.blurb: Solve as many sums as you can before the timer runs out.

odd-one-out.name: Odd One Out
odd-one-out.blurb: Spot the one tile that stands out. The grid keeps growing.

higher-lower.name: Higher or Lower
higher-lower.blurb: Higher or lower? Build a streak and bank it when you dare — a miss halves it.

bug-smash.name: Bug Smash
bug-smash.blurb: Smash the bugs, dodge the bombs. Fastest hands win.

stop-clock.name: Stop the Clock
stop-clock.blurb: Stop the needle as close to the target as you can. Three tries.

memory-flash.name: Memory Flash
memory-flash.blurb: Count the flash — how many of the target colour did you see?

simon.name: Simon
simon.blurb: Watch the sequence, then repeat it. It grows every round.

pixel-hoops.name: Pixel Hoops
pixel-hoops.blurb: Charge and release to sink the basket. Chain them for combos.

pixel-weight.name: Pixel Weight
pixel-weight.blurb: A pixel object flashes — guess how many pixels it is made of.

pixel-split.name: Pixel Split
pixel-split.blurb: Cut the object in two halves with the same number of pixels.

tug-of-war.name: Tug of War
tug-of-war.blurb: Two teams, one rope. Mash together to pull the marker to your side.
tug-of-war.tagline: Teamwork: always someone else to blame.

sink-the-fleet.name: Sink the Fleet
sink-the-fleet.blurb: Head-to-head Battleship — a hit shoots again. Sink your rival's fleet before they sink yours.
sink-the-fleet.tagline: Somewhere out there, a tiny admiral is crying.

bomb-relay.name: Bomb Relay
bomb-relay.blurb: Pass the bomb down your team — mash your leg and hand it off before the fuse blows.
bomb-relay.tagline: Hot potato, short fuse, shorter friendships.

pixel-beat.name: Pixel Beat
pixel-beat.blurb: Tap along to the beat before it fades. Timing is everything.

fleet-battle.name: Fleet Battle
fleet-battle.blurb: Team Battleship — a rotating captain calls each shot, then the whole crew can fire. Sink the enemy fleet first.

maze-sprint.name: Maze Sprint
maze-sprint.blurb: Race through the same maze as everyone else. Fastest exit wins.

line-clear-sprint.name: Line Clear Sprint
line-clear-sprint.blurb: Stack pixels, clear lines, beat the clock. Most lines wins.

quick-tetris.name: Quick Tetris
quick-tetris.blurb: A short, frantic Tetris sprint — first to clear the target lines wins.

bubble-pop.name: Bubble Pop
bubble-pop.blurb: Shoot color-matched bubbles to pop groups of three or more. Most bubbles popped wins; a full clear beats them all.

fruit-catch.name: Fruit Catch
fruit-catch.blurb: Slide your basket to catch the falling fruit — and dodge the bombs.

pixel-rain.name: Pixel Rain
pixel-rain.blurb: Dodge the falling blocks. Last one standing wins.
pixel-rain.tagline: It's raining blocks. Nobody brought an umbrella.

pixel-dash.name: Pixel Dash
pixel-dash.blurb: Tap to jump the obstacles as they rush in. Clear the most to win.

snake-arena.name: Snake Arena
snake-arena.blurb: Your own board, the same apples as everyone: eat, grow, don't crash. Longest snake wins.

pixel-pong.name: Pixel Pong
pixel-pong.blurb: Head-to-head pong. First to five points takes the duel.
pixel-pong.tagline: Two paddles, one ball, zero mercy.

sumo-push.name: Sumo Push
sumo-push.blurb: Shove and charge everyone out of a shrinking ring. Last sumo standing wins.

match-pairs.name: Match
match-pairs.blurb: Flip the cards and clear every matching pair before anyone else.

quick-draw.name: Quick Draw
quick-draw.blurb: Wait for FIRE, then draw first. Flinch early — or not at all — and you lose.
quick-draw.tagline: The undertaker is already taking measurements.

pixel-roulette.name: Pixel Roulette
pixel-roulette.blurb: Spin for a random number. Highest wins — pure luck.

sudoku-race.name: Sudoku Race
sudoku-race.blurb: Everyone solves the same mini sudoku. Fastest correct grid wins.

micro-race.name: Micro Race
micro-race.blurb: Tiny cars, tabletop tracks. Three laps, bump your rivals, first across the line wins.

dash-100m.name: 100m Dash
dash-100m.blurb: Alternate LEFT and RIGHT as fast as you can to sprint. Wait for the gun!

hurdles-110m.name: 110m Hurdles
hurdles-110m.blurb: Sprint with LEFT/RIGHT and JUMP each hurdle. Clip one and you lose your speed.

long-jump.name: Long Jump
long-jump.blurb: Sprint down the runway, hold JUMP at the board to set the angle, release to fly. 3 tries.

javelin-throw.name: Javelin
javelin-throw.blurb: Build speed, hold THROW before the line to aim, release to launch. Longest throw wins.

glass-bridge.name: Glass Bridge
glass-bridge.blurb: Cross one by one: LEFT or RIGHT? Blind guesses that hold earn ★. Peeking at the glint is safe, but earns nothing.
glass-bridge.tagline: Half the panels are tempered glass. The other half are a funeral.

freeze-doll.name: Freeze Doll
freeze-doll.blurb: Hold to walk while she sings, freeze before she turns. Her laser spots any twitch!
freeze-doll.tagline: She sings, you walk. She turns, you'd better be furniture.

room-rush.name: Room Rush
room-rush.blurb: A number is called: pack a room with exactly that many. Shove, dash, slam the door!
room-rush.tagline: Musical chairs, except losing is permanent.

sumo-ice.name: Sumo ICE
sumo-ice.blurb: Sumo on a melting ice floe: slide, shove and stay on the ice. Last one dry wins!
sumo-ice.tagline: The ice is thin. So is your dignity.

pang.name: Pang
pang.blurb: Harpoon the bouncing balloons: each hit splits them smaller. Most pops wins, dodge them all!
pang.tagline: Pop the balloons before they pop you.

star-blaster.name: Star Blaster
star-blaster.blurb: Same waves for everyone: weave through the bullet storm, your ship fires itself. Top score wins.

asteroids.name: Asteroids Arena
asteroids.blurb: One shared wrap-around sky: rotate, thrust, shoot. Rocks pay, rival ships pay more!
asteroids.tagline: In space, no one can hear you blame the lag.

bomber-express.name: Bomber Express
bomber-express.blurb: Everyone starts maxed out: huge blasts, five bombs, fast boots. Last one standing wins!
bomber-express.tagline: Leave your friends a present. It ticks.

brawl.name: Street Brawl
brawl.blurb: One street, everybody fighting: punch combos, kicks, throws, pipes and chicken. Last one up wins!
brawl.tagline: Friendship ends where the bottle begins.

rally-stage.name: Rally Stage
rally-stage.blurb: Point-to-point against the clock: gravel slides, tarmac grips, split times. Fastest stage wins.

speed-circuit.name: Speed Circuit
speed-circuit.blurb: Two laps wheel-to-wheel: tuck into the slipstream, hit the boost pads, take the flag first.

honeycomb-cut.name: Honeycomb Cut
honeycomb-cut.blurb: Trace the shape in the candy with your needle. Stray off the line or rush and it cracks — a broken candy counts half!
honeycomb-cut.tagline: Steady hands. Crack the candy and the candy cracks you.

jump-rope.name: Jump Rope
jump-rope.blurb: A giant rope swings faster and faster: tap to jump as it sweeps under you. Two misses and you are out!
jump-rope.tagline: Skip or trip. The rope doesn't care.

marbles-duel.name: Marbles Duel
marbles-duel.blurb: Odd or even? Hide marbles in your fist, bet on your rival’s. Win them all to win the duel.
marbles-duel.tagline: Take their marbles. Then take their dignity.

weird-trivia.name: Weird Trivia
weird-trivia.blurb: Strange but true: pick the real answer among the absurd ones. Fast answers score more.

spectating: You are out — enjoy the show
Out. Your ghost may heckle freely.
Eliminated. Have you tried being better?
Out. Your funeral is next round.
Spectator mode: a fancy word for lost.
